scholarships.title: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.funding_label: Monthly stipend, health insurance, and some travel costs

existing.eligibility_summary: Master's applicants must be 29 or under; PhD applicants 35 or under. Cannot be currently studying in France. Cannot combine with another French government scholarship.
benefits: Monthly stipend (amount set annually by Campus France), health insurance, some travel costs
coverage: Monthly stipend (amount set annually by Campus France), health insurance, some travel costs
documents: Exact list set by the host French institution
existing.english_requirement: Not centrally specified - varies by the specific Master's/PhD programme (French or English-taught)
existing.best_fit: Only for applicants who already have to be selected/nominated by a French university - cannot apply directly as an individual
existing.notes: IMPORTANT: Students CANNOT apply directly. A French higher education institution must select and submit the application on the student's behalf. A student must first get an offer/interest from a French university, then ask that university to nominate them for Eiffel.
existing.deadline_display: Call opens ~October 1, national deadline ~January 8 (exact dates shift slightly each year)
